import urllib.request
import json

def get_canonical_details(accession):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{accession}.json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Python'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    
    gene_name = data.get('genes', [{}])[0].get('geneName', {}).get('value')
    protein_name = data.get('proteinDescription', {}).get('recommendedName', {}).get('fullName', {}).get('value')
    seq_info = data.get('sequence', {})
    
    # check alternative isoforms
    comments = data.get('comments', [])
    isoforms = []
    for c in comments:
        if c.get('commentType') == 'ALTERNATIVE PRODUCTS':
            for iso in c.get('isoforms', []):
                isoforms.append({
                    'id': iso.get('isoformIds'),
                    'name': iso.get('name', {}).get('value'),
                    'sequenceStatus': iso.get('sequenceStatus')
                })
    return {
        'accession': accession,
        'gene': gene_name,
        'protein': protein_name,
        'length': seq_info.get('length'),
        'mass_da': seq_info.get('molWeight'),
        'mass_kda': round(seq_info.get('molWeight') / 1000, 2),
        'isoforms': isoforms
    }

print("ELL2 (O00472):", get_canonical_details("O00472"))
print("SMYD4 (Q8IYR2):", get_canonical_details("Q8IYR2"))

import urllib.request
import json

# Check Q8IYR2 isoform 2
def get_isoform_mass(isoform_id):
    url = f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{isoform_id}.fasta"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Python'})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
            lines = resp.read().decode().splitlines()
            seq = "".join(lines[1:])
            # calculate weight
            # standard amino acid weights
            aa_weights = {
                'A': 71.08, 'R': 156.20, 'N': 114.11, 'D': 115.09, 'C': 103.14,
                'E': 129.12, 'Q': 128.13, 'G': 57.06, 'H': 137.15, 'I': 113.17,
                'L': 113.17, 'K': 128.18, 'M': 131.21, 'F': 147.18, 'P': 97.12,
                'S': 87.08, 'T': 101.11, 'W': 186.21, 'Y': 163.18, 'V': 99.13
            }
            mass = sum(aa_weights.get(aa, 110.0) for aa in seq) + 18.015
            return len(seq), mass
    except Exception as e:
        return str(e)
